front: Which of these is a JavaScript primitive?
back: Primitives (string, number, boolean, null, undefined, symbol, bigint) are immutable. Array and Object are reference types.

front: What is the capital of Australia?
back: Canberra — chosen as a compromise between rivals Sydney and Melbourne.

front: Which organelle produces most of a cell's ATP?
back: Mitochondria run oxidative phosphorylation to generate ~32 ATP per glucose — the 'powerhouse' of the cell.

front: The Great Wall of China is visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
back: A popular myth. At lunar distance (~384,000 km) the wall is far too narrow for the naked eye.

front: Water boils at 100°C at sea level under standard atmospheric pressure.
back: At 1 atm, water's boiling point is exactly 100°C.

front: The adult human body contains 206 bones.
back: Babies have ~270 bones, many of which fuse during growth. Adults end up with 206.

front: Match each sorting algorithm to its worst-case complexity
back: Worst-case and average-case often differ — quick sort's O(n²) worst comes from pathological pivot choices.

front: Match each Greek philosopher to their core idea
back: These shorthand maxims gloss much deeper bodies of work.

front: Order the planets by distance from the Sun
